pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pChanges Time, Rain or Thunder after its powered/redstone-driven operation completes.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Choose the mode and desired state.$p2. Supply FE and a redstone signal.$p3. Maintain power through the configured operating duration, then allow its cooldown.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pUnlike many ordinary machines, no redstone signal means no operation. If the world already has the target state, another change may be unnecessary.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
